title: mpy-registry.yaml — MicroPython Registry Package Manifest
description: Metadata manifest that lives at the root of a PACKAGE AUTHOR'S OWN repo, as mpy-registry.yaml (or at install_path if not repo root). It is not stored in the micropython-registry repo itself — that repo only lists the author's repo URL in packages.txt and fetches this file from it at index-build time. This manifest describes HOW the package is categorized/installed — it does not replace the package's own mip package.json.

name.description: Unique registry package name. Lowercase, kebab-case, used for --index short-name installs in Phase 6.

version.description: Current version of the package, semver format.

description.description: One-line summary shown in search results and package listings.

author.description: Package author. Either a plain name string or an object with contact details.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0-or-later).

repo_url.description: Optional self-reference to this repo's own URL. Not used to locate the package (packages.txt already provides that) — only as a cross-check that a manifest wasn't copy-pasted from a different package without updating this field.

homepage.description: Optional project homepage or documentation URL, if different from repo_url.

install_path.description: Optional subdirectory within the repo containing the installable package (its mip package.json / module root), for monorepo-style repos where the package isn't at repo root. This mpy-registry.yaml manifest itself is always read from repo root regardless of install_path.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for search, beyond the fixed category.

compatible_ports.description: MicroPython ports this package is known to work on. Omit if unknown/untested; empty/omitted does not mean incompatible.

compatible_boards.description: Optional free-form list of specific boards this package has been tested on (e.g. 'ESP32-S3 DevKitC', 'Raspberry Pi Pico W').

min_micropython_version.description: Optional minimum required MicroPython firmware version, e.g. '1.22.0'.

dependencies.description: Other registry packages this package depends on.

name.description: Name of the dependency as registered in this registry.

version.description: Version constraint, e.g. '^1.2.0' or '>=1.0.0'. Omit to mean 'latest'.
